title: PV3900 (PV39-8048 TLV) optional BMS block captured with a CAN-connected BMS
summary: Owner unit reports model PV3900 at 20000-20001 and uses the common MUST telemetry conventions (charge-negative battery current/power, fractional load percent). With a PACE BMS on CAN (PYLON_CAN), local FC03 registers 109-114 returned 549, 65356, 36, 0, 99, 100 while the BMS app and SmartValue both showed 99% SOC, 100% SOH and 36 C; 109 tracked the inverter battery voltage (54.9 V).
